assets.name: will i dream
assets.author: GANTASMO
assets.summary: A song in 6/8 that steps into additive 33/8 twice, with a locator on every change.
assets.description: The project opens at 118.79 bpm in 6/8 with the whole song on one audio track. Six locators mark what the rhythm engine read: two passages of 33/8, grouped 3+2+3+3 and then 3+2+2+2+2, inside a song that is otherwise compound duple. Locator colours follow bar length, so the odd sections stand out on the timeline. Press MAP in DETAILS to run the analysis yourself and compare it against the markers. Suggested order: look at the timeline, run the meter map, then open SCORE.

assets.name: House of the Rising Sun
assets.author: GANTASMO
assets.summary: A tempo change from 162 to 199 bpm, with the meter moving through 5/8 and 12/8.
assets.description: Nine locators, including an amber marker at the tempo change 39 seconds in. The meter passes through 6/8, 5/8 grouped 2+3, and two 12/8 passages, one of them grouped 3+2+2+3+2. The swing ratio the engine read here is 1.28, so the eighths are noticeably uneven. Open it in SING to put the lyric beside the score, and in DETAILS to read the map.

assets.name: Miracle Mile
assets.author: GANTASMO
assets.summary: Six named scenes for the PERFORM grid over a song that moves between 2/4, 4/4, 8/4 and 6/4.
assets.description: The longest of the five, with thirteen locators covering four tempo changes and nine meter segments. Six scenes are named in the project (Intro, Verse, Turn, Chorus, Break, Out) so the PERFORM grid opens with a row per section rather than a generic ladder. The engine read cross-rhythms at 4:3 and 2:3 in three separate segments, which is what the 8/4 passage grouped 3+3+2 is doing.

assets.name: Gravy
assets.author: GANTASMO
assets.summary: A three-stage mastering chain on the track, over a song that alternates 6/8, 9/8 and 15/8.
assets.description: The audio track carries an EQ, a compressor and a reverb, one of each, with values you can read and change: the compressor sits at -18 dB with a ratio of 2.5, the reverb is 12 percent wet. Open MIX to see the chain, bypass a stage and hear what it was doing. Ten locators mark the meter, which moves from 6/8 into 9/8, back, through a 15/8 passage grouped 2+3, and ends in 9/8.

assets.name: Everything is Chrome in the Future
assets.file: projects/Everything is Chrome in the Future.tasmo
assets.author: GANTASMO
assets.summary: Five and a half minutes at a steady tempo, the simplest of the five to start with.
assets.description: Four locators and no tempo change, so this is the one to open first if the others look busy. The whole song sits on one track with fades at both ends. Use it to learn the timeline, then run the meter map in DETAILS and export the report to see what an analysis contains.

assets.name: The Owl
assets.author: GANTASMO
assets.summary: The bundled Owl control surface as a .gan package.
assets.description: A web plugin built from a VST Foundry export: artwork, canvas surfaces and the controls that drive them. Installing it puts the package on the plugin shelf and extracts its runtime, the same path a plugin you build yourself takes.

assets.name: Ares
assets.author: GANTASMO
assets.summary: The Ares control surface as a .gan package.
assets.description: The control surface the MIX Studio tile opens, packaged as a .gan. Install it to put it on the plugin shelf, or download the file to open it in FOUNDRY and edit the layout.
